name: M&Y International Financial Services
what_they_do: Small accounting and tax practice offering individual and business tax preparation, bookkeeping/accounting, commercial property tax appeals, new-business formation, notary and immigration-adjacent services; also runs a tax-refund-advance promotion and a mobile tax app. Notable niche in non-profit and charter/public school fiscal management (budget prep, grant reporting, audits).
customers: Individuals and families, small/mid-sized businesses, and non-profit and educational organizations (charter schools, early-childhood providers, school districts); Spanish-language pages indicate a bilingual client base.

size_signals.signal: Team page names four people: founder/CFO Dr. Mars Mellish, an executive administrative assistant, and two accountants
Site text says the firm has been operating 'for eleven (11) years' (founded ~2012 by the footer copyright)
Publishes a fee-module based bookkeeping offer with a 10% new-customer discount and offers free booking slots of 30 min, 1 hr and 2 hr

website_review.primary_cta: SCHEDULE APPOINTMENT NOW graphic linking to Wix Bookings; phone number in footer only as plain text
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Wix Bookings page with three free tax appointments (30 min / 1 hr / 2 hr) and Book Now buttons
website_review.trust_signals: Founder bio with doctorate and 12+ years in school fiscal management; named staff with bios; 'honesty, integrity, experience, commitment'; Spanish-language mirror pages; no reviews or client testimonials on site
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer copyright '© 2012'; homepage banner still promotes '2019 Individual & Business Tax Highlights' and a refund advance 'starting January 3, 2023'; 'New Client Questionnaire' page is blank apart from the footer; pricing page lists modules but no actual prices
website_review.search_basics: Cookie-cutter title pattern 'M&Y International Financial Services | New Brunswick | NJ | Home' does name the town; Wix pages have descriptions; each service (tax, accounting, property tax appeal, other business services) has its own page
top_issues: Mobile layout is broken: at 390px the site renders a desktop-width canvas, so the firm name and service cards are cut off horizontally and the nav collapses to bare text links.
No phone link (tel:) and no contact form anywhere on the site - the only conversion paths are an email address, a plain-text number, and the booking widget.

Content is years out of date (2012 copyright, 2019 tax highlights, 2023 refund advance), the client questionnaire page is empty, and no price ranges are published, which undermines trust for a firm selling tax help.

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt allows all agents (only PetalBot blocked, sitemap published). Wix injects LocalBusiness JSON-LD that matches the address and phone but has no hours, service list or price range. Services and staff are written as readable text; hours are absent. Booking is genuinely online (Wix Bookings, three free appointment lengths) - an agent could book without a phone call.

operations_signals.signal: Free 30-min to 2-hour tax appointments booked straight into staff calendars - inference: staff currently absorb a high volume of season appointments with one admin assistant.

Bookkeeping offer is sold by transaction volume with 'LedgerDocs' and 'Hosting' modules - inference: client document exchange already partly digital, but no secure upload/portal is exposed on the site.
Site advertises a 'New Client Questionnaire' but the page is empty, so new-client intake is effectively manual via email/phone.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile site and rebuild it on a modern responsive theme with a tel: click-to-call, a labelled intake form and current-year content (hours, services, fee ranges).
top_opportunities.evidence: 390px render shows a cropped desktop canvas; no tel links or forms on the site; footer and homepage content date from 2012-2023.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Digital new-client intake with document checklist and automated reminders (W-2s, prior returns, 1099s) so tax-season admin is collected before the appointment.
top_opportunities.evidence: New Client Questionnaire page is blank; the only intake channels are email and phone.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add hours, service area, price ranges and richer LocalBusiness schema so search engines and AI agents can answer 'what does a tax appointment cost / when are they open'.
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD has address and phone only; pricing page lists service modules with no numbers.

scores.reasons: Mobile-broken, dated, form-less site with an empty questionnaire page is a big visible gap and cheap to fix; a four-person practice has moderate budget and the niche (school/non-profit fiscal work) suggests stable revenue.
